description: Statically analyze R code and search R package signatures with flowR queries (https://github.com/flowr-analysis/flowr/wiki/Query-API). Common ones: {"type":"static-slice","criteria":["12@x"]} for the code affecting x in line 12, {"type":"linter"} for lint findings, {"type":"dependencies"} for loaded libraries, read and written files, {"type":"guess-dep-versions"} for the package versions the code works with, {"type":"call-context","callName":"^read_"} for calls, and, needing no code, {"type":"signature","package":"dplyr","function":"across"} to search signatures and versions (globs allowed), {"type":"function-info","name":"filter"} for the packages exporting a function. A query with wrong arguments is answered with its schema. Types: call-context (Call-Context Query), config (Config Query), control-flow (Control-Flow Query), call-graph (Call-Graph Query), dataflow (Dataflow Query), does-call (Does-Call Query), dataflow-lens (Dataflow Lens Query), absint (Abstract Interpretation Query), files (Files Query), id-map (Id-Map Query), normalized-ast (Normalized AST Query), dataflow-cluster (Dataflow Cluster Query), static-slice (Static Slice Query), provenance (Provenance Query), input-sources (Input Sources Query), dependencies (Dependencies Query), location-map (Location Map Query), search (Search Query), happens-before (Happens-Before Query), inspect-exception (Inspect Exceptions of Functions Query), inspect-higher-order (Inspect Higher-Order Functions Query), inspect-recursion (Inspect Recursive Functions Query), inspect-fn-props (Inspect Argument Roles Query), resolve-value (Resolve Value Query), project (Project Query), signature (Signature Query), origin (Origin Query), linter (Linter Query), dice (Dice Query), guess-dep-versions (Guess Dependency Versions Query), function-info (Function Info Query)

files.description: R files or project folders to analyze.

name: query
